name: luna-worker-planner
description: Plan and govern projects while reusing codebase context across luna_worker tasks and critically evaluating their results.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, delegate, and critically evaluate results.
interface.longDescription: Use this conversation as the project planner and controller. For repository code work, it first builds a compact Project Context Packet and reuses relevant context across self-contained luna_worker tasks, avoiding repeated repository discovery while critically reviewing results.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Luna Worker Planner to build and reuse project context across luna_worker code tasks, critically review their reports, and make independent planning decisions.
